# Synthesis Summary — Election Cycle Fixture

## Top Findings

Electoral-cycle dual brief combining EP10 retrospective scorecard (vote-share delta, mandate fulfilment, defection-flow map) with forward seat projections, coalition viability matrix, and Spitzenkandidaten arithmetic for the 2029 election.

## Retrospective Scorecard (EP10 Mid-Term)

- EPP vote-share delta: +2.3 % from 2024 election baseline — mandate over-performance.
- S&D defection rate: 6.2 % on average (low) — strong internal cohesion.
- Renew mandate fulfilment: 61 % (below 68 % mid-term benchmark) — risk of seat erosion.

## Forward Seat Projections (to 2029)

Coalition viability matrix indicates EPP-S&D-Renew centrist majority viable at 67 % probability under baseline scenario. Far-right super-majority (ECR+PfE+ID successors) structurally blocked at current trajectory.

## Spitzenkandidaten Arithmetic

EP President seat likely EPP-held for second cycle. Commissioner nominee map favours balanced S&D-EPP-Renew split contingent on post-election coalition architecture.
